children: officially launched the Li i9 SUV on Wednesday. The Chinese electric vehicle maker has the six-seat electric family SUV positioned as one of its flagship models.
The Li i9 is being offered solely in the “Home” trim at RMB369,800 (about $54,000). Notably, the i9 is Li Auto's

largest SUV to date and sits above the Li i8. It measures 5,225 mm long with a 3,168 mm wheelbase, giving it the extra room needed for a more spacious three-row layout and a cabin designed around family comfort.
Leading into the launch, Li Auto

highlighted the i9’s lounge-like interior. It includes four zero-gravity seats, with rotating second-row seats that can face each other, plus a 29-inch 6K panoramic display and a movable 21-inch rear 4K entertainment screen. Under the hood, the i9 has a 400 kW dual-motor all-wheel-drive system, a 101 kWh battery, and a claimed 705 km of CLTC range. Li Auto
noted its 5C charging system can add up to 500 km of CLTC range in 10 minutes. Deliveries are expected to begin this week.

title: Li Auto makes a premium SUV push with the new i9 model launch
